content.bridge_context: Learning how to build and simplify mathematical expressions using letters and numbers.

units.title: Terms and Factors
units.explanation: An expression like 4x + 5 has two terms: 4x and 5. Factors of 4x are 4 and x.
units.dual_language_instruction: List terms in '2y - 3'. / '2y - 3' में पदों (terms) की सूची बनाएं।

units.title: Like and Unlike Terms
units.explanation: Like terms have the same algebraic factors (e.g., 2x and 5x). Unlike terms don't (e.g., 2x and 3y).
units.dual_language_instruction: Are 4ab and 7ba like terms? / क्या 4ab और 7ba सजातीय पद (like terms) हैं?
